{
  "contents": "// Configuration manager to handle application settings\nclass ConfigManager {\n  constructor() {\n    this.config = {};\n    this.loadConfig();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load configuration from localStorage\n   */\n  loadConfig() {\n    try {\n      // First try to load from localStorage\n      const savedConfig = localStorage.getItem(\"translator_rewriter_config\");\n      if (savedConfig) {\n        this.config = JSON.parse(savedConfig);\n      } else {\n        this.config = {};\n      }\n\n      // If running in Electron, try to load from file and merge\n      if (window.electronAPI) {\n        const fileConfig = window.electronAPI.readConfig();\n        if (fileConfig) {\n          this.config = { ...this.config, ...fileConfig };\n          console.log(\"Loaded config from file:\", this.config);\n        }\n\n        if (Object.keys(this.config).length === 0) {\n          this.setDefaultConfig();\n        }\n      } else {\n        if (Object.keys(this.config).length === 0) {\n          this.setDefaultConfig();\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error loading config:\", error);\n      this.setDefaultConfig();\n    }\n  }\n\n  setDefaultConfig() {\n    this.config = {\n      api_key: \"\",\n      last_used_model: \"\",\n      available_models: [],\n      available_languages: [],\n      auto_copy: false,\n      real_time_translation: false,\n      enter_behavior: \"Translate\",\n      font_family: \"Arial\",\n      font_size: 14,\n      input_text_color: \"#ffffff\",\n      output_text_color: \"#ffffff\",\n      window_geometry: \"1000x700\",\n      settings_modal_geometry: { width: 950, height: 640 },\n      total_cost: 0.0,\n      api_url: \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\",\n    };\n  }\n\n  persistToFile() {\n    try {\n      const electronRequire =\n        typeof window !== \"undefined\" &amp;&amp; window.require ? window.require : null;\n      if (!electronRequire) return;\n      const fs = electronRequire(\"fs\");\n      const path = electronRequire(\"path\");\n      const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), \"config.json\");\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(this.config, null, 2), \"utf8\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error writing config file:\", error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Save configuration to localStorage and disk (Electron)\n   */\n  saveConfig() {\n    try {\n      localStorage.setItem(\n        \"translator_rewriter_config\",\n        JSON.stringify(this.config),\n      );\n      this.persistToFile();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error saving config:\", error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get a configuration value\n   * @param {string} key - Configuration key\n   * @returns {*} Configuration value\n   */\n  get(key) {\n    return this.config[key];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set a configuration value\n   * @param {string} key - Configuration key\n   * @param {*} value - Configuration value\n   */\n  set(key, value) {\n    this.config[key] = value;\n    this.saveConfig();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get all configuration\n   * @returns {Object} All configuration\n   */\n  getAll() {\n    return { ...this.config };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set multiple configuration values\n   * @param {Object} config - Configuration object\n   */\n  setAll(config) {\n    this.config = { ...this.config, ...config };\n    this.saveConfig();\n  }\n}\n\nexport default new ConfigManager();\n",

m.id === modelId)?.pricing;\n    const promptRate = parseFloat(pricing?.prompt ?? 0);\n    const completionRate = parseFloat(pricing?.completion ?? 0);\n    if (promptRate || completionRate) {\n      return promptTokens * promptRate + completionTokens * completionRate;\n    }\n    // If pricing is missing, treat as free (avoid default/fallback pricing).\n    return 0;\n  };\n\n  const writeLastApiResult = (payload) =&gt; {\n    configManager.setAll(newSettings);\n    const updatedSettings = configManager.getAll();\n    setSettings(updatedSettings);\n\n    // Update the API service base URL when settings change\n    apiService.setBaseUrl(\n      updatedSettings.api_url || \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\",\n    );\n  };\n\n  // Update a single setting\n  const setSetting = (key, value) =&gt; {\n    configManager.set(key, value);\n    const updatedSettings = configManager.getAll();\n    setSettings(updatedSettings);\n\n    // Update the API service base URL when settings change\n    if (key === \"api_url\") {\n      apiService.setBaseUrl(value || \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\");\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Translate text\n  const translate = async (text, targetLang, model, sourceLang = null) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await apiService.translate(\n        text,\n        targetLang,\n        model,\n        sourceLang,\n      );\n\n      // Update last used model\n      // Do not overwrite last_used_model here; it is persisted via user selection in the header.\n\n      // Update total cost if applicable\n      if (result.usage) {\n        const { prompt_tokens = 0, completion_tokens = 0 } = result.usage;\n        const calculatedCost = computeCostFromUsage(\n          model,\n          prompt_tokens,\n          completion_tokens,\n        );\n        const newTotalCost = (settings.total_cost || 0) + calculatedCost;\n        setSetting(\"total_cost\", newTotalCost);\n        result.calculated_cost = calculatedCost;\n        result.total_cost = newTotalCost;\n      }\n\n      result.model_used = result.model || model;\n\n      writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"translate\",\n        model: result.model_used,\n        usage: result.usage,\n        calculated_cost: result.calculated_cost,\n        total_cost: result.total_cost,\n        raw: result,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"Translation failed\");\n      console.error(err);\n      return { error: err.message };\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Rewrite text\n  const rewrite = async (text, style, model) =&gt; ## Summary of Changes

1. Removed right margin — content uses the full window width
   - Updated CSS to remove margins and set width to 100%

2. General tab improvements:
   - Removed "Cancel" and "Save & Close" buttons and the footer panel (footer only shows for Models and Languages tabs)
   - Changed the "×" close button to a "Close" button with text label

3. Languages tab updates:
   - Added top 15 most spoken languages by native speakers (Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, English, Hindi, Arabic, etc.)
   - Added top 10 most spoken languages in Europe (Russian, German, French, Italian, English, etc.)
   - Added a custom language text field that saves on Enter or blur

4. Auto-save implementation:
   - Settings persist immediately on change (no save button needed)
   - General tab: each setting change calls `setSetting()` to save immediately
   - Models tab: model selections are saved immediately
   - Languages tab: language selections are saved immediately
   - Custom languages are saved when added

All changes are implemented and ready to test. The settings window now uses the full width, has a cleaner General tab without footer buttons, includes the requested language lists, and auto-saves all changes immediately.

        "contents": "class App(ctk.CTk):\n\n\n    def setup_left_panel(self):\n        self.left_panel.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)\n        self.left_panel.grid_rowconfigure(1, weight=1)\n\n        # Controls (Dynamic based on mode)\n        self.left_controls = ctk.CTkFrame(self.left_panel, fg_color=\"transparent\")\n        self.left_controls.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=\"ew\", pady=5, padx=5)\n\n        # Translate Mode Controls\n        self.source_lang_var = ctk.StringVar(value=\"Detect Language\")\n        self.source_lang_dropdown = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(\n            self.left_controls,\n            variable=self.source_lang_var,\n            values=[\"Detect Language\"],\n        )\n\n        # Rewrite Mode Controls\n        self.style_var = ctk.StringVar(value=\"Check Spelling &amp; Grammar\")\n        styles = [\n            \"Check Spelling &amp; Grammar\",\n            \"Improve Clarity\",\n            \"Make Formal\",\n            \"Make Informal\",\n            \"Shorten\",\n            \"Expand\",\n            \"Make Technical\",\n        ]\n        self.style_dropdown = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(\n            self.left_controls, variable=self.style_var, values=styles, width=200\n        )\n\n        # Input Box\n        self.input_box = ctk.CTkTextbox(self.left_panel, wrap=\"word\")\n        self.input_box.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=\"nsew\", padx=5, pady=5)\n        self.input_box.bind(\"&lt;KeyRelease&gt;\", self.on_input_change)\n        self.input_box.bind(\"&lt;Return&gt;\", self.on_enter_pressed)\n        self.input_box.bind(\"&lt;Shift-Return&gt;\", self.on_shift_enter_pressed)\n\n        # Bottom Bar (Stats + Buttons)\n        bottom_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.left_panel, fg_color=\"transparent\")\n        bottom_frame.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky=\"ew\", pady=5, padx=5)\n\n        self.input_stats = ctk.CTkLabel(\n            bottom_frame,\n            text=\"Chars: 0 | Words: 0 | Paragraphs: 0\",\n            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11),\n        )\n        self.input_stats.pack(side=\"left\")\n\n        ctk.CTkButton(\n            bottom_frame,\n            text=\"Clear\",",

        "contents": "class App(ctk.CTk):\ndef setup_right_panel(self):\n\n\n        self.run_btn = ctk.CTkButton(\n            bottom_frame, text=\"Translate\", width=100, command=self.run_action\n        )\n        self.run_btn.pack(side=\"right\", padx=5)\n\n        ctk.CTkButton(\n            bottom_frame,\n            text=\"Copy\",\n            width=60,\n            command=lambda: self.copy_text(self.output_box),\n        ).pack(side=\"right\", padx=5)\n\n    def open_settings(self):\n        dialog = SettingsDialog(self, self.config_manager)\n        self.wait_window(dialog)\n        self.update_config_dependent_ui()\n        self.apply_appearance_settings()\n\n    def update_config_dependent_ui(self):\n        # Models\n        models = self.config_manager.get(\"available_models\")\n        if models:\n            self.model_dropdown.configure(values=models)\n            last_used = self.config_manager.get(\"last_used_model\")\n            if last_used in models:\n                self.model_var.set(last_used or \"\")\n            else:\n                self.model_var.set(models[0])\n        else:\n            self.model_dropdown.configure(values=[\"No Models Configured\"])\n            self.model_var.set(\"No Models Configured\")\n\n        # Languages\n        langs = self.config_manager.get(\"available_languages\")\n        self.target_lang_dropdown.configure(values=langs)\n        source_langs = [\"Detect Language\"] + (langs or [])\n        self.source_lang_dropdown.configure(values=source_langs)\n\n        # Ensure correct controls are shown\n        self.set_mode(self.mode_var.get())\n\n    def apply_appearance_settings(self):\n        font_family = self.config_manager.get(\"font_family\")",

        "contents": "const App = \nconst activeModel = \n);\n\n  // Available styles for rewrite mode\n  const rewriteStyles = [\n    \"Check Spelling &amp; Grammar\",\n    \"Improve Clarity\",\n    \"Make Formal\",\n    \"Make Informal\",\n    \"Shorten\",\n    \"Expand\",\n    \"Make Technical\",\n  ];\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Set default target language if available languages exist\n    if (languages.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; targetLanguage === \"Spanish\") {\n      setTargetLanguage(languages[0]);\n    }\n  }, [languages]);\n\n  const handleModeChange = (mode) =&gt; {\n    setCurrentMode(mode);\n  };\n\n  const clearInput = () =&gt; {\n    setInputText(\"\");\n  };\n\n  // Cleanup timer on unmount\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    return () =&gt; {\n      if (timerRef.current) {\n        clearInterval(timerRef.current);\n      }\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const copyOutput = () =&gt; {\n    navigator.clipboard.writeText(outputText);\n  };\n\n  const pasteToInput = () =&gt; {\n    navigator.clipboard\n      .readText()\n      .then((text) =&gt; {\n        setInputText(text);\n      })\n      .catch((err) =&gt; {\n        console.error(\"Failed to read clipboard contents: \", err);\n      });\n  };\n\n  const getInputStats = () =&gt; {\n    const text = inputText;\n    const chars = text.length;\n    const words = text.trim() ? text.trim().split(/\\s+/).length : 0;\n    const paragraphs = text.trim()\n      ? text.split(/\\n\\s*\\n/).filter((p) =&gt; p.trim()).length\n      : 0;\n\n    return &#96;Chars: ${chars} | Words: ${words} | Paragraphs: ${paragraphs}&#96;;\n  };\n\n  const getOutputStats = () =&gt; {\n    const text = outputText;\n    const chars = text.length;\n    const words = text.trim() ? text.trim().split(/\\s+/).length : 0;\n    const paragraphs = text.trim()\n      ? text.split(/\\n\\s*\\n/).filter((p) =&gt; p.trim()).length\n      : 0;\n\n    return &#96;Chars: ${chars} | Words: ${words} | Paragraphs: ${paragraphs}&#96;;\n  };\n\n  const formatCostDisplay = (cost) =&gt; {\n    if (!cost || cost &lt;= 0) return \"free\";\n    if (cost &lt; 0.01) return &#96;c$${(cost * 100).toFixed(4)}&#96;;\n    return &#96;$${cost.toFixed(4)}&#96;;\n  };\n\n  const openSettings = () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "class App(ctk.CTk):\n\n\n    def create_header(self):\n        self.header_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self, corner_radius=0, height=60)\n        self.header_frame.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=\"ew\", padx=0, pady=0)\n        self.header_frame.grid_propagate(False)\n\n        self.title_label = ctk.CTkLabel(\n            self.header_frame,\n            text=\"Translator &amp; Rewriter\",\n            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=20, weight=\"bold\"),\n        )\n        self.title_label.pack(side=\"left\", padx=20, pady=10)\n\n        self.settings_btn = ctk.CTkButton(\n            self.header_frame, text=\"⚙️\", width=40, command=self.open_settings\n        )\n        self.settings_btn.pack(side=\"right\", padx=10)\n\n        self.model_var = ctk.StringVar(value=\"Select Model\")\n        self.model_dropdown = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(\n            self.header_frame, variable=self.model_var, values=[]\n        )\n        self.model_dropdown.pack(side=\"right\", padx=10)\n\n        ctk.CTkLabel(self.header_frame, text=\"Model:\").pack(side=\"right\", padx=5)\n\n    def create_mode_selector(self):\n        # Compact mode selector\n        mode_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=\"transparent\", height=40)\n        mode_frame.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=\"ew\", padx=20, pady=(5, 0))\n        mode_frame.grid_propagate(False)\n\n        self.mode_var = ctk.StringVar(value=\"Translate\")\n\n        self.translate_btn = ctk.CTkButton(\n            mode_frame,\n            text=\"Translate\",\n            width=100,\n            command=lambda: self.set_mode(\"Translate\"),\n        )\n        self.translate_btn.pack(side=\"left\", padx=5)\n\n        self.rewrite_btn = ctk.CTkButton(\n            mode_frame,\n            text=\"Rewrite\",\n            width=100,\n            fg_color=\"gray\",\n            command=lambda: self.set_mode(\"Rewrite\"),\n        )\n        self.rewrite_btn.pack(side=\"left\", padx=5)\n\n    def set_mode(self, mode):\n        self.mode_var.set(mode)",

        "contents": "const App = \nconst handleTranslate = async \n\n\n    try {\n      const result = await translate(\n        inputText,\n        targetLanguage,\n        activeModel,\n        sourceLanguage === \"Detect Language\" ? null : sourceLanguage,\n      );\n\n      // Calculate TPS\n      const endTime = Date.now();\n      const durationSeconds =\n        (endTime - tpsCalculationRef.current.startTime) / 1000;\n      const totalTokens =\n        (result.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0) +\n        (result.usage?.completion_tokens || 0);\n      const tps = durationSeconds &gt; 0 ? totalTokens / durationSeconds : 0;\n      setTokensPerSecond(tps);\n\n      // Stop timer\n      if (timerRef.current) {\n        clearInterval(timerRef.current);\n        timerRef.current = null;\n      }\n      startTimeRef.current = null;\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n      setLastRunCost(result.calculated_cost || 0);\n      setLastRunModel(result.model_used || lastRunModel || null);\n\n      if (result.content) {\n        const cleanedContent = result.content.replace(/^\\s*\\n+/, \"\");\n        setOutputText(cleanedContent);\n        // Auto-copy if enabled\n        if (settings.auto_copy) {\n          navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanedContent);\n        }\n      } else if (result.error) {\n        setOutputText(&#96;Error: ${result.error}&#96;);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Stop timer on error\n      if (timerRef.current) {\n        clearInterval(timerRef.current);\n        timerRef.current = null;\n      }\n      startTimeRef.current = null;\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n      setLastRunCost(0);\n      setLastRunModel(null);\n      setOutputText(&#96;Error: ${error.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRewrite = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!inputText.trim()) return;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "class App(ctk.CTk):\ndef setup_left_panel(self):\n\n\n        ctk.CTkButton(\n            bottom_frame,\n            text=\"Clear\",\n            width=60,\n            fg_color=\"gray\",\n            command=lambda: self.clear_text(self.input_box),\n        ).pack(side=\"right\", padx=5)\n        ctk.CTkButton(\n            bottom_frame,\n            text=\"Paste\",\n            width=60,\n            command=lambda: self.paste_text(self.input_box),\n        ).pack(side=\"right\", padx=5)\n\n    def setup_right_panel(self):\n        self.right_panel.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)\n        self.right_panel.grid_rowconfigure(1, weight=1)\n\n        # Top Bar (Timer + Target Lang)\n        top_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.right_panel, fg_color=\"transparent\")\n        top_frame.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=\"ew\", pady=5, padx=5)\n\n        self.timer_label = ctk.CTkLabel(\n            top_frame, text=\"0.0s\", font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12, weight=\"bold\")\n        )\n        self.timer_label.pack(side=\"left\", padx=5)\n\n        self.cost_label = ctk.CTkLabel(top_frame, text=\"\", font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12))\n        self.cost_label.pack(side=\"left\", padx=10)\n\n        self.target_lang_var = ctk.StringVar(value=\"Spanish\")\n        self.target_lang_dropdown = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(\n            top_frame, variable=self.target_lang_var, values=[]\n        )\n\n        # Output Box\n        self.output_box = ctk.CTkTextbox(\n            self.right_panel, state=\"disabled\", wrap=\"word\"\n        )\n        self.output_box.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=\"nsew\", padx=5, pady=5)\n\n        # Bottom Bar (Stats + Cost + Copy + Run)\n        bottom_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.right_panel, fg_color=\"transparent\")\n        bottom_frame.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky=\"ew\", pady=5, padx=5)\n\n        self.output_stats = ctk.CTkLabel(\n            bottom_frame,\n            text=\"Chars: 0 | Words: 0 | Paragraphs: 0\",\n            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11),\n        )\n        self.output_stats.pack(side=\"left\")\n\n        self.run_btn = ctk.CTkButton(\n            bottom_frame,",

        "contents": "class App(ctk.CTk):\n\n\n    def set_mode(self, mode):\n        self.mode_var.set(mode)\n        if mode == \"Translate\":\n            self.translate_btn.configure(fg_color=(\"gray75\", \"gray25\"))\n            self.rewrite_btn.configure(fg_color=\"gray\")\n            self.source_lang_dropdown.pack(side=\"left\")\n            self.style_dropdown.pack_forget()\n            self.target_lang_dropdown.pack(side=\"right\")\n            self.run_btn.configure(text=\"Translate\")\n        else:\n            self.translate_btn.configure(fg_color=\"gray\")\n            self.rewrite_btn.configure(fg_color=(\"gray75\", \"gray25\"))\n            self.source_lang_dropdown.pack_forget()\n            self.style_dropdown.pack(side=\"left\")\n            self.target_lang_dropdown.pack_forget()\n            self.run_btn.configure(text=\"Rewrite\")\n\n    def create_work_area(self):\n        # Container for PanedWindow\n        container = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=\"transparent\")\n        container.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky=\"nsew\", padx=20, pady=(5, 10))\n\n        self.paned_window = tk.PanedWindow(\n            container, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, sashwidth=6, bg=\"#2b2b2b\", bd=0\n        )\n        self.paned_window.pack(fill=\"both\", expand=True)\n\n        # Left Panel (Input)\n        self.left_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(self.paned_window)\n        self.paned_window.add(self.left_panel, minsize=300)\n\n        # Right Panel (Output)\n        self.right_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(self.paned_window)\n        self.paned_window.add(self.right_panel, minsize=300)\n\n        # Set equal initial sizes\n        self.after(\n            100,\n            lambda: self.paned_window.sash_place(\n                0, self.paned_window.winfo_width() // 2, 0\n            ),\n        )\n\n        self.setup_left_panel()\n        self.setup_right_panel()\n\n    def setup_left_panel(self):\n        self.left_panel.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)",

        "contents": "}\n\n/* Text Areas */\n.text-area {\n    flex: 1;\n    width: 100%;\n    min-height: 0;\n    resize: none;\n    background-color: transparent;\n    color: var(--text-primary);\n    border: none;\n    padding: var(--spacing-xs) 0;\n    font-family: \"Consolas\", \"Monaco\", monospace; /* Better for editing */\n    font-size: 15px;\n    line-height: 1.5;\n    outline: none;\n}\n\n.text-area::placeholder {\n    color: var(--text-disabled);\n}\n\n/* Controls &amp; Status Bar inside Panel */\n.controls {\n    display: flex;\n    justify-content: space-between;\n    align-items: center;\n    padding-top: var(--spacing-xxs);\n    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);\n    margin-top: var(--spacing-xxs);\n}\n\n.stats {\n    font-size: 12px;\n    color: var(--text-disabled);\n}\n\n/* Buttons */\n.buttons {\n    display: flex;\n    gap: var(--spacing-sm);\n}\n\n.btn {\n    padding: 6px 16px;\n    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);\n    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);\n    cursor: pointer;\n    background-color: var(--surface-color);\n    color: var(--text-primary);\n    font-size: 13px;\n    font-weight: 500;\n    transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n\n.btn:hover {\n    background-color: var(--surface-hover);\n    border-color: var(--text-secondary);\n}\n\n.btn.primary {\n    background-color: var(--accent-color);\n    border-color: var(--accent-color);\n    color: #000;\n}\n\n.btn.primary:hover {\n    background-color: var(--accent-hover);\n    border-color: var(--accent-hover);\n}\n\n.btn.small {\n    padding: 4px 8px;\n    font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.btn.xsmall {\n    padding: 2px 6px;\n    font-size: 11px;\n}\n\n/* Selectors (Language/Style) */\n.language-selector,\n.style-selector {\n    margin: 0 var(--spacing-xs) var(--spacing-sm) var(--spacing-xs);\n    display: flex;\n    align-items: center;\n    gap: var(--spacing-sm);\n}\n\n.language-selector label,\n.style-selector label {\n    font-size: 14px;\n    color: var(--text-secondary);\n    min-width: 45px;\n}\n\n.language-dropdown,\n.style-dropdown {\n    flex: 1;\n    padding: 8px 12px;",

        "contents": "class SettingsDialog(ctk.CTkToplevel):\n\n\n    def setup_languages_tab(self):\n        ctk.CTkLabel(\n            self.tab_languages, text=\"Select languages to appear in dropdowns:\"\n        ).pack(pady=10, padx=10, anchor=\"w\")\n\n        self.languages_scroll = ctk.CTkScrollableFrame(self.tab_languages)\n        self.languages_scroll.pack(fill=\"both\", expand=True, padx=10, pady=10)\n\n        all_languages = [\n            \"Arabic\",\n            \"Bengali\",\n            \"Brazilian Portuguese\",\n            \"Chinese\",\n            \"Dutch\",\n            \"English\",\n            \"English (US)\",\n            \"English (UK)\",\n            \"French\",\n            \"German\",\n            \"Hindi\",\n            \"Indonesian\",\n            \"Italian\",\n            \"Japanese\",\n            \"Korean\",\n            \"Polish\",\n            \"Portuguese\",\n            \"Russian\",\n            \"Spanish\",\n            \"Spanish (ES)\",\n            \"Spanish (Latam)\",\n            \"Turkish\",\n            \"Vietnamese\",\n        ]\n        all_languages.sort()\n\n        current_langs = set(self.config_manager.get(\"available_languages\") or [])\n        self.lang_checkboxes = []\n\n        for lang in all_languages:\n            var = ctk.StringVar(value=lang if lang in current_langs else \"\")\n            cb = ctk.CTkCheckBox(\n                self.languages_scroll,\n                text=lang,\n                variable=var,\n                onvalue=lang,\n                offvalue=\"\",\n            )\n            cb.pack(anchor=\"w\", pady=2)\n            if lang in current_langs:\n                cb.select()\n            self.lang_checkboxes.append(cb)\n\n    def fetch_models(self):\n        api_key = self.api_key_entry.get()",

{
  "contents": "// API service to communicate with the backend\nclass APIService {\n  constructor() {\n    this.baseUrl = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\";\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set the base URL for API requests\n   * @param {string} url - The base URL to use for API requests\n   */\n  setBaseUrl(url) {\n    this.baseUrl = url;\n  }\n\n  getHeaders() {\n    const config = require(\"../utils/configManager\").default.getAll();\n    return {\n      \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n      Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${config.api_key || \"\"}&#96;,\n      \"HTTP-Referer\":\n        \"https://github.com/TranslateRewrite/translator-and-rewriter\", // Required by OpenRouter\n      \"X-Title\": \"Translator &amp; Rewriter\", // Optional\n    };\n  }\n\n  writeLastApiResult(payload) {\n    try {\n      const electronRequire =\n        typeof window !== \"undefined\" &amp;&amp; window.require ? window.require : null;\n      if (!electronRequire) return;\n      const fs = electronRequire(\"fs\");\n      const path = electronRequire(\"path\");\n      const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), \"last_api_result.json\");\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), \"utf8\");\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to write last_api_result.json\", err);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Translate text from source language to target language\n   * @param {string} text - Text to translate\n   * @param {string} targetLang - Target language\n   * @param {string} model - Model to use for translation\n   * @param {string} sourceLang - Source language (optional)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Object&gt;} Translation result with content and usage\n   */\n  async translate(text, targetLang, model, sourceLang = null) {\n    try {\n      let prompt;\n      if (sourceLang &amp;&amp; sourceLang !== \"Detect Language\") {\n        prompt = &#96;You are a professional translator. Translate the following text from ${sourceLang} into ${targetLang}. Only provide the translation, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;;\n      } else {\n        prompt = &#96;You are a professional translator. Translate the following text into ${targetLang}. Only provide the translation, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;;\n      }\n\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          model: model,\n          messages: [\n            { role: \"system\", content: prompt },\n            { role: \"user\", content: text },\n          ],\n        }),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!data.choices || data.choices.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error(\"No choices returned from API\");\n      }\n\n      const result = {\n        content: data.choices[0].message.content,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        model: model,\n      };\n\n      this.writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"translate\",\n        model,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        raw: data,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Translation error:\", error);\n      return {\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Rewrite text with specified style\n   * @param {string} text - Text to rewrite\n   * @param {string} style - Style to apply\n   * @param {string} model - Model to use for rewriting\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Object&gt;} Rewrite result with content and usage\n   */\n  async rewrite(text, style, model) {\n    try {\n      const stylePrompts = {\n        \"Check Spelling &amp; Grammar\":\n          \"Correct the spelling and grammar of the following text. Maintain the original meaning.\",\n        \"Improve Clarity\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to improve its clarity and flow.\",\n        \"Make Formal\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to make it more formal and professional.\",\n        \"Make Informal\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to make it more casual and informal.\",\n        Shorten:\n          \"Condense the following text, keeping only the essential information.\",\n        Expand: \"Expand on the following text, adding more detail and context.\",\n        \"Make Technical\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text using more technical terminology appropriate for the context.\",\n      };\n\n      const prompt = stylePrompts[style] || \"Rewrite the following text.\";\n\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          model: model,\n          messages: [\n            {\n              role: \"system\",\n              content: &#96;${prompt} Only provide the rewritten text, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;,\n            },\n            { role: \"user\", content: text },\n          ],\n        }),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!data.choices || data.choices.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error(\"No choices returned from API\");\n      }\n\n      const result = {\n        content: data.choices[0].message.content,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        model: model,\n      };\n\n      this.writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"rewrite\",\n        model,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        raw: data,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Rewrite error:\", error);\n      return {\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get list of available models\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Array&gt;} List of available models\n   */\n  async getModels() {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/models&#96;, {\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n      return data.data || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching models:\", error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get list of available languages\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Array&gt;} List of available languages\n   */\n  async getLanguages() {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/languages&#96;);\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n      return data.languages || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching languages:\", error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport default new APIService();\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 219
}

## Summary of Changes

### Settings > Languages Tab:
1. Removed section labels — removed "Top 15 Most Spoken Languages (Native Speakers)" and "Top 10 Most Spoken languages in Europe"
2. Updated language names:
   - "English" → "English (US)"
   - "Portuguese" → "Portuguese (PT)"
3. Added new languages:
   - "Brazilian Portuguese"
   - "English (UK)"
   - "Spanish (ES)"
4. Alphabetical sorting — all languages are sorted alphabetically in a single list

### Translate Dropdowns:
1. "To:" dropdown — shows only selected languages from Settings > Languages tab (alphabetically sorted)
2. "From:" dropdown — shows:
   - "Detect Language" first
   - Selected languages (alphabetically sorted)
   - A separator line
   - Remaining languages from Settings > Languages tab (alphabetically sorted)

### Implementation Details:
- Created a shared `languageConstants.js` file with all predefined languages
- Updated `LanguageSelector` to support selected/remaining languages with a separator
- Updated `App.js` to pass the correct language lists to the dropdowns
- All languages (predefined + custom) are properly handled and sorted

Changes are complete and ready to test. The language lists are now unified, alphabetically sorted, and the dropdowns use the selected languages as specified.

## Summary of Changes

1. Removed footer panel — removed the bottom panel with "Cancel" and "Save & Close" buttons for all tabs.
2. Full-width content — updated CSS so content uses the full available width:
   - Removed margins from `.modal-body`, `.tab-content`, and `.settings-body`
   - Set `width: 100%` and `box-sizing: border-box` on relevant elements
   - Ensured `.modal` uses full width

The settings window now uses the full width, and the footer with buttons has been removed. Settings continue to auto-save on change, so no save button is needed. The "Close" button in the header remains for closing the window.
